cc:Work.dc:title: Per-IP rate-limit throughput · 1 thread
cc:Work.dc:description: Criterion measurements. Logarithmic key counts, zero-based linear throughput. Throughput is in millions of checks per second. Higher is better. Mixed IPv4/IPv6 clients with 20% shared hot-client traffic. Bottlecap and Governor use fixed-seed rapidhash and their default clocks.
